name: Simple Affiliate
description: Basic referral/affiliate system: a per-user affiliate link sets a tracking cookie, and new registrations record the referring user in a user reference field.
project_description: Simple Affiliate is a very basic affiliate module for Drupal 8 sites. It provides a link for all registered members on the site available in a block. The link is unique to the specific user. The registered users can share this link via email, affiliate ads or HTML affiliate links on their website. Any user who clicks on this link will have a cookie with the unique id of the user who shared the link set in their browser. A user with the cookie who registers on the site within a specific time will be marked as a referral of the user who shared the link.
